title: Phone polish wave 0: fake league-night data and admin sign-in for screenshots
request: Doug: 'plan a polish of the entire app especially the mobile experience' (approved plan, 2026-11-09). Wave 0 = setup only: shoot.mjs mock init hook for a fake admin session, a fake league-night data mock, baseline shots, and the in-repo plan file with the per-wave defect list. No app change.

criteria.text: shoot.mjs: a --mock module may also export init and initArg; init(initArg) runs in every page before app code (context.addInitScript). The empty-blocklist guard is unchanged. factory/spec/shoot.spec.mjs proves it with a real browser and fails when the hook is removed.
criteria.evidence: Commit f0e6567: shoot.mjs imports the mock module once and, when it exports a function init, calls context.addInitScript(init, initArg) for each viewport context; the empty-blocklist branch is untouched. New spec case (real Chromium, local page that reports its localStorage value through a blocked-host request): with init the report reads 'GET api.blocked.test/seen/seeded', without init 'seen/none'. With the addInitScript line replaced by a comment the case fails (expected seeded, got none); restored, all 3 shoot specs pass.

criteria.text: A fake league-night mock (.factory/fixtures/, fake names only) fills the phone screens the waves need: schedule tonight, a live match mid-game, finished matches with comments, message board posts, a bracket, a recap edition, history, pending scores, and a fake admin session for /admin sections. A shoot run over every route sends nothing to a live host: every Supabase request is answered locally.

Baseline shots of every route at 390 and 1280 px plus a 320 px overflow and tap scan, and docs/plans/PHONE-POLISH-2026-11.md holds the per-wave defect list from that baseline. No app source file changes in this wave.
Required checks pass on the final head (typecheck, lint, unit, build, knip, integrity) plus factory-specs, and an independent code review approves.
